title: 天体语义字场变体｜成年观测者让轨道、脉冲与引力成为文字
source_title: 星图轨道字场｜天体脉动驱动字形宇宙
summary: 同一明确成年观测者以眼神、手势与身体轴触发轨道、脉冲和引力短词；文字成为可测量的天体结构，并在尺度升级后回到同一人物与单一结论。
input_format: Establish one clearly adult original subject, three identity anchors and one continuous world axis. + Bind each decisive action to exactly one short original semantic word that appears only after the action begins. + Make each word occupy, divide, reflect or redirect the physical environment rather than float as a subtitle. + Escalate typography scale and spatial depth while preserving identity, travel direction and readable action. + Return to the same adult face or full-body anchor and resolve the word sequence into one terminal identity proof.
recommended_input: 原创暗色海洋实验室中，一名明确成年东亚海洋学家穿白色工作服站在圆形黑水池旁；锁定脸、短发和水池坐标。；她单次挥手，准确短词【TIDE】与【DEPTH】分别成为同一池内的上升圆环和向下刻度。；所有等高线收回成她眼旁一滴水；同一成年人面对镜头，准确终局词【RETURN】在她身后细圆环内落稳。
required_anchors: Establish one clearly adult original observer and fixed celestial coordinate anchors.
Require a visible gaze, hand or body action before each exact semantic word appears.
Escalate from body-scale diagrams to cosmic scale while preserving observer identity and coordinate continuity.
Collapse the celestial system back to the same observer and one readable terminal word.
